answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the forge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the pigment of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the signal re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
